units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 7. Architectural and urban planning design materials nominated for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize attached to the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the expert council).
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 8. The Regulations on the expert council, the procedure for considering architectural and urban planning design materials nominated for the Prize and the criteria for their evaluation shall be established by a legal act of the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 9. Where the expert council considers architectural and urban planning design materials authored by its members, those members shall not take part in the vote.
units.label: Point 9

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 10. Following consideration of the architectural and urban planning design materials nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meeting a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes.
units.label: Point 10

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 11. The architectural and urban planning design materials selected by the expert council shall be forwarded to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 11

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
units.label: Point 11 · “On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 12. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
units.label: Point 12

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 13. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
units.label: Point 13

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 14. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in architecture and urban planning.
units.label: Point 14

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 1. The “Stork’s Wings” Prize of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for a special contribution to the development of family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2. The Prize shall be awarded annually on the eve of World Orphans Day in the following categories:
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2.1. Family of the Year.
units.label: Point 2.1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2.2. Organization of the Year.
units.label: Point 2.2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2.3. Person of the Year.
units.label: Point 2.3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2.4. Benefactor of the Year.
units.label: Point 2.4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 3. The Prize shall be awarded as follows:
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 3.1. In the “Family of the Year” category: up to three Prizes to adoptive families, families of guardians (curators), foster families or patronage-care families.
units.label: Point 3.1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 3.2. In the “Organization of the Year” category: up to five Prizes to staff collectives of guardianship and curatorship bodies, organizations for orphans and children left without parental care, schools for foster parents, nonprofit organizations and other organizations, and to collectives of public associations that have made a special contribution to the development of family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 3.2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 3.3. In the “Person of the Year” category: up to three Prizes to statespersons, political and public figures, figures in science and culture, representatives of the mass media and representatives of other fields who have made a special contribution to the development of family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 3.3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 3.4. In the “Benefactor of the Year” category: one Prize to persons conducting charitable activities in the field of developing family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 3.4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 4. The Prize need not be awarded in individual categories.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 5. Materials shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow by collectives of organizations, public associations and creative unions, and by state authorities and local self-government bodies.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Materials shall be accepted by the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow annually from 15.01 to 15.04 of the current year.
units.label: Point 5 · “Materials shall be accepted by the Department of Labour and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 6. Candidates shall not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize in two or more categories.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 7. Materials submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize attached to the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the expert council).
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The regulations and membership of the expert council, the procedure for considering and criteria for evaluating materials submitted for the Prize, and the description of the statuette of the “Stork’s Wings” Prize of the City of Moscow shall be established by a legal act of the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 7 · “The regulations and membership of the expert council, the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 8. After discussing the materials nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Where members of the expert council are nominated for the Prize, they shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
units.label: Point 8 · “Where members of the expert council are nominated for the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 9. The materials selected by the expert council shall be forwarded to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 9

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
units.label: Point 9 · “On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 10. In addition to the breast badge “Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow” and the diploma of a laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow, laureates shall be presented with the statuette of the “Stork’s Wings” Prize of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 10

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 11. Where the Prize is awarded in the “Family of the Year” category, one of the adoptive parents, guardians (curators), foster parents or patronage-care parents in the family shall receive a cash award of 1000 thousand roubles.
units.label: Point 11

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: The cash award shall be paid by the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
units.label: Point 11 · “The cash award shall be paid by the Department of Labour and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “STORK’S WINGS” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 12. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new achievements in developing family placement for orphans and children left without parental care in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 12

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Tourism (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the most significant activities and works aimed at developing the tourism potential of the City of Moscow, improving the quality and attractiveness of tourism services and the efficiency of the use of tourism resources, developing tourism infrastructure located in the City of Moscow, implementing new investment projects in tourism and hospitality, introducing best practices and standards in hospitality services, improving forms of tourist and excursion services, creating and promoting new tourism products and services, and introducing digital technologies in tourism and the hospitality industry of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 2. Up to 10 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of World Tourism Day.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow by state authorities, local self-government bodies and organizations.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be accepted by the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow annually until 01.04, provided that they were made public at least one year before the closing date for submissions.
units.label: Point 3 · “Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be accepted…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 4. Simultaneous nomination for the Prize for two or more activities and works is not permitted.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 5. A team submitting materials and works for the Prize must include only those authors whose contribution to the work was decisive.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: A team of authors may not comprise more than ten persons.
units.label: Point 5 · “A team of authors may not comprise more than ten persons.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 6. Materials and works submitted for the Prize, and teams submitting materials and works for the Prize, shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or other awards.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 7. Materials and works may be submitted for the Prize only after publication, broad public discussion and implementation in the practice of tourism and the hospitality industry.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: Those materials and works shall be discussed among the staff collectives of organizations and in the mass media. Materials from the discussions shall be sent to the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 7 · “Those materials and works shall be discussed among the staff…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 8. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the expert council) attached to the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 9. After discussing the materials and works submitted for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
units.label: Point 9

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: Where materials and works authored by members of the expert council are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from participation in the expert council’s work.
units.label: Point 9 · “Where materials and works authored by members of the expert…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 10. The materials and works selected by the expert council shall be forwarded by the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 10

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 11. On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
units.label: Point 11

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 12. The Prizes shall be paid by the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
units.label: Point 12

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 13. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
units.label: Point 13

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN TOURISM
units.text: 14. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in tourism.
units.label: Point 14

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMENDATION OF THE MAYOR OF MOSCOW
units.text: The Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall be granted to citizens of the Russian Federation and foreign citizens and to collectives of institutions and organizations for meritorious economic, research, sociocultural, public and charitable activities aimed at improving the living conditions of Muscovites, for high achievements in training qualified personnel, educating the younger generation and maintaining legality and law and order, and for many years of impeccable work in the municipal economy of the City of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMENDATION OF THE MAYOR OF MOSCOW · “The Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall be granted to…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMENDATION OF THE MAYOR OF MOSCOW
units.text: Citizens granted the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE COMMENDATION OF THE MAYOR OF MOSCOW · “Citizens granted the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall…”

units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: The honorary title “Honorary Worker in Industry of the City of Moscow” shall be conferred on:
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW” · “The honorary title “Honorary Worker in Industry of the City of…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - highly skilled workers and forepersons who have achieved high performance in output, product quality improvement and labour productivity and have worked directly on machine tools, units, apparatus, installations or process equipment of industrial organizations of the City of Moscow for at least 10 years;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW” · “- highly skilled workers and forepersons who have achieved high…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - highly professional workers, forepersons and engineering and technical personnel of industrial associations and organizations who have especially distinguished themselves in improving equipment, technology and production organization, made a major personal contribution to improving product quality, expanding product ranges and reducing production costs, raising labour productivity and production efficiency through mechanization and automation of production processes and scientific advances, and making rational use of capacity and material resources, and have worked in the industry of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW” · “- highly professional workers, forepersons and engineering and…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE HONORARY TITLE “HONORARY WORKER IN INDUSTRY OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - highly professional researchers who have made a major personal contribution to technical progress, the development and introduction of new equipment and technologies, and the organization of production and labour, and have worked in research, design and development or other organizations and institutions of the City of Moscow for at least 15 years.
